adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff, `refreshOAuthTokens` in `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts` returns either the response from `fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, ...)` (a Fetch Response object) or the result of `refreshFunction()`. In GoogleCalendarService, the `refreshFunction` returns `fetchTokens.res` which is a Gaxios response with a `.data` property. However, when credential sync is enabled, `refreshOAuthTokens` returns a raw Fetch Response object which does NOT have a `.data` property - it has methods like `.json()`. So on line 94, `const token = res?.data;` would be undefined when using the credential sync endpoint, causing line 95 `googleCredentials.access_token = token.access_token;` to throw. This is a real bug in the integration between the new credential sync feature and Google Calendar.
